integrity: All formulas admit exact integer polynomial verification. No independent audit or independent validation is claimed; general priority is not certified.
scientific_limitations: Exact assertions concern the specified integral equilateral conic–line model over fields of characteristic zero or prime characteristic at least five. Characteristics two and three give nonreduced factors and are excluded. The gradient ideal is not interchangeable with the Tjurina ideal; no claim is made for arbitrary integral coordinate changes.
title: Uniform logarithmic freeness and a characteristic-seven Jacobian jump for an equilateral conic–line arrangement
